style.checked_requirement: Tactile monochrome documentary photography; silver highlights, charcoal shadows, controlled grain, real hand/soil/root contacts, different crop distances; firm modern sans main Title and crisp mature regular body.

observations.observation: Skin creases, earth particles and branching roots carry fine gray detail. Two cropped hands surround and support a compact rootball attached to leaf-bearing stems.
Much closer crop concentrates on fingertips touching loose soil and pale roots; grain remains restrained and midtones distinguish skin, earth and roots.
Wider view shows a rooted plant in a rough-textured pot grounded on a workbench with soil and a watering can. The pot's bottom has a visible seated contact and shadow.
Broad bold open sans Title, medium Subtitle, regular paragraph and restrained serif date/hour remain a coherent monochrome editorial voice.

ratio.policy_observation: One edge is nearest-integer native rounding within the predeclared tolerance. No resize performed.

observations.observation: Supporting a rooted plant, touching and loosening its soil/roots, and a stable planted result form content-bearing photographic moments of choosing and caring. They organize the left rhythm rather than acting as small decoration.
The broad right Title is the main typographic anchor; the sequence of left images gives a second clear entry. Subtitle is distinctly subordinate.
Paragraph starts share one left axis; a clear gap leads to date, then hours/place, then adjacent access/care and invitation/URL pairs. No search among unrelated corners is needed.
Syllable blocks retain mature proportions, open counters, consistent stem weights and separated Korean words. No fused or missing Hangul block was read.
Full prose and all practical lines are readable. Text remains clean against charcoal without photo grain covering counters or punctuation.
Upper palm steadies the rootball from behind/side while lower hand supports its lower front; soil contact and finger boundaries are legible.
Finger pads visibly touch the soil and connected root mass; pale fine roots branch through the soil rather than float as detached marks.
Plant stems enter soil inside the pot; the pot sits with a believable base and contact shadow.

Narrow dark horizontal gutters cut the three passages cleanly; silver photographic highlights preserve local texture. Type edges are crisp and flat; no added stamps, pseudo-text, logo, QR or watermark was observed.

default_style_exclusion.observation: The three substantial care-action photographs carry different contact distances and organize half the composition. The stable reading column answers their grower/care content. This is an image-led documentary sequence with useful type, not a passive information template with subordinate tiny imagery.

format.observation: One flat opaque landscape poster; the three passages are legitimate content photographs inside that single composition, not three posters or a mockup.

residuals.observation: The tighter root close-up crops the stem connection outside its boundary; the top passage supplies the visible rootball-to-stem connection.
The thumbnail supports hierarchy and image rhythm, but the smallest copy requires the inspected 720px or native view to read.

selection_reason: Retain initial: no definite missing/altered entry or broken contact was observed after the single native revisit; photographic content, assigned style and continuous readable copy relationship are retained without a repair.
